headline: Eyal's laptop sign-in is fixed and live: after 'Send link' the app asks for the code from the email, and the beta-password door says it is not the account sign-in. His 29 Oct report (see every past discussion) was already fixed by #25. Spoken lines no longer go silent when the gateway hangs: after 6 seconds the browser voice reads them.

voice_status: Speech-to-text: the browser's own recogniser where it works. On iPhone/iPad, or after it fails once, the mic records and the gateway transcribes with Whisper (20 s timeout). Recording stops after 2.5 s of quiet when dictating and 1.2 s in Talk mode, gives up after 10 s of nothing heard, and the hard cap is 60 s. Silence is judged by loudness only, so a noisy room can keep it recording to the cap. Voices: the gateway gives each adviser a voice; the code comment says Aura-1, not Aura-2 (the gateway decides; not visible from this repo). Where the gateway can't speak, the browser's voice reads at natural pitch and speed (Eyal, 29 Oct). Fixed now (#30): a gateway that hung on one line used to silence that line and every line after it; now each line gets 6 s and then the browser voice reads it, and the next line waits for it to finish. Not measured: Whisper accuracy and latency, and voice latency. Those need the gateway's logs or the analytics table (SQL), which wait for Pavol.
